title: Fossil Gear
description: Fossil Gear is an official "Amaranthium" addon made by my brother, adding some gear.
body:
Welcome to my brother's first mod, He & I hope you enjoy, as he worked hard on this mod, which has taken a year, as my brother is new to modding.

This mod adds the following:
1. Tar Ore
2. Tar Ingots
3. Tar Blocks
4. Tar Sword
5. Tar Axe
6. Tar Pickaxe
7. Tar Shovel
8. Tar Hoe
9. Tar Helmet
10. Tar Chestplate
11. Tar Leggings
12. Tar Boots
13. "Volcanic Wastes" Biome
14. 'Dehyrdatrated Water' (From this StevenHe video: [Fish Bowl S2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x__1yoEIkDs&list=PLnTjNwFX3opQ-eqSkj9zlfP6SXL7uNX3D&index=3))
15. Tar
16. Tar bucket
16. Volcanic Helmet
17. Volcanic Chestplate
18. Volcanic Leggings
19. Volcanic Boots
20. Petrified Logs
21. Land Mine (Made by "axisthejester")
22. Gelatinous Flail (Made by "axisthejester")
23. "Eew Sticky" Advancement.



This mod's role is to add a primal feel to your world, with the Volcanic Wastes Biome that spawns in the overworld.
the few weapons have a couple of effects, so please try them out.
to fully optimise this mod, JEI is helpful, as to find the recipes for the different Items.
Thank you for playing, Please enjoy.

"Hope you enjoy my first mod."
- quaitheprimitive (my brother)
